bio.text: Anna Moeller is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 43rd District, serving since March 2014, according to the Illinois General Assembly.
Moeller's legislature biography says Moeller holds a BA in history and an MPA from Northern Illinois University and was an Edgar Fellow at the University of Illinois.
It says Moeller is a former Elgin city councilwoman and former executive director of the McHenry County Council of Governments.
